QUOTE: "So `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` compiles to `ctx->private_state` by default. A user who writes `ctx->state` gets a compile error"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the macro renames the member (private_ prefix) so that access by the plain name fails at compile time. That is the member-name-breaking mechanism. It never says the layout is hidden, so the layout stays visible.
